title: next/image returns 400 '"url" parameter is not allowed' for a localhost or private-network image source
symptoms: Server log: upstream image ... hostname resolved to private IP
Images from a local Strapi or WordPress on localhost break after upgrading, though remotePatterns lists the host
cause: Next.js 16 blocks the image optimizer from fetching any host that resolves to a private IP, as SSRF protection. remotePatterns does not override it, and split-horizon DNS inside a VPC trips it too.
fix: Enable images.dangerouslyAllowLocalIP only in development or on a private network you control, or serve the images from a public host.
